bioconda.name: instanovo
bioconda.summary: InstaNovo enables diffusion-powered de novo peptide sequencing in large scale proteomics experiments.

biotools.summary: InstaNovo is a transformer neural network with the ability to translate fragment ion peaks into the sequence of amino acids that make up the studied peptide(s).
